findings.location: Paragraph — source: “I thought that was what was going on.”
findings.source_quote: “I thought that was what was going on,” I replied.
findings.suggested_fix: Render the meaning more closely to the English original. Suggested Korean: “그게 무슨 일인지라고 생각했습니다.” or “그게 바로 그런 상황인 줄 알았어요.” Keep surrounding HTML identical.

findings.source_quote: It is only through the Holy Spirit’s power that we can provide the care that is needed for someone whose body is strong, but who no longer even recognizes you.
findings.suggested_fix: Combine or tighten the two Korean sentences that duplicate the original thought so they reflect the single English sentence. Suggested Korean (preserve p tags): "오직 성령의 능력을 통해서만, 몸은 건장하나 더 이상 당신을 알아보지 못하는 사람에게 필요한 돌봄을 제공할 수 있습니다."
findings.translation_quote: 온전한 돌봄을 제공할 수 있는 것은 오직 성령의 능력뿐이다. 신체는 강하지만 더 이상 당신을 알아보지 못하는 사람을 돌보는 데 필요한 것은 성령의 능력이다.
